source_row.rationale: Arterial line placement provides continuous, beat-to-beat blood pressure monitoring, allowing precise, safe titration of IV antihypertensive medications in hypertensive emergency, more accurate than intermittent cuff measurements.
source_row.source_detail: Purpose of Arterial Line in Hypertensive Emergency
